The '''Klepthia system''' was located within the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Species/Legends|species]] known as [[Klepthian rock otter]]s.<ref name="Luke" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Klepthia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square N-14.<ref name="TEA" />
